title: RESIDENTIAL TENANCY AGREEMENT
key_sentences: This agreement is made on 1 November 2026 between the parties named below.
It creates a tenancy of a dwelling house and sets out the rights and duties of both parties.
The first payment is due on the date of this agreement.
Any increase must be notified to the Tenant at least one month before it takes effect.
Deductions may only be made for unpaid rent, damage beyond fair wear and tear, or missing items listed in the inventory.
The Tenant is advised to arrange separate insurance for personal belongings.
A final inspection will be carried out in the presence of the Tenant if the Tenant so wishes.
The Landlord confirms that the gas safety record and the energy performance certificate have been given to the Tenant.
The Tenant confirms receipt of two sets of keys and a copy of the full inventory.

list_items.text: (a) to keep the interior of the Property clean and in good condition;
(b) not to make any alterations or additions to the Property without the written consent of the Landlord;
(c) not to keep any animal at the Property, except one cat or one small caged animal;
(d) to report promptly to the Landlord any disrepair or defect in the Property;
(e) to allow the Landlord access at reasonable times on at least twenty-four hours’ written notice;
(f) not to sublet or part with possession of the whole or any part of the Property.
(a) to allow the Tenant to occupy the Property without interruption, except as provided in this agreement;
(b) to keep in repair the structure and exterior of the Property, including drains, gutters and external pipes;
(c) to keep in repair and proper working order the installations for the supply of water, gas, electricity and heating;
(d) to arrange an annual gas safety check by a registered engineer and give the Tenant a copy of the record.
